what: this release's build: the reader stem's two 3D convolutions as inkrs tensor-core kernels with their InstanceNorm fused, and four host-side fixes (the cuDNN algorithm cache, the CLI's first read overlapped with start-up, and in the villa adapter a lazy PyTorch model, one read per window and the first read overlapped with the engine's start); its gates against villa eager and hecate.py; and two timings, each against the build before that change. No end-to-end timing of this build is in results/; the README's headline timings come from the earlier build

gates.note: each tier ran with its own empty cuDNN algorithm cache and the default --algo find; sm80 is INKRS_PTX_TIER=sm80 forced on the RTX 5090; the reader-v2 inputs are those of reader-v2-p1.json, the hybrid_3d2d-seed42 input is S1

against_stem_kernels_only.note: the same maps from the build with the stem kernels but not the host fixes, run in the same job; -h is --algo heuristic

kernel_time_us_per_slot.note: nsys kernel time per tile slot, reader-v2 at batch 64, 50 forwards, one traced run

stem_kernels_sweep.what: inkrs sweep of reader-v2 over the whole PHerc. 1447 segment (native, 31 x 2980 x 3240), d -2..2, both directions, batch 64, 10 maps: passes[0].total_s, the first sweep pass with start-up excluded, one pass per process, the build with the stem kernels against the build before them; 2 untimed warm-up runs, then 6 pairs in alternating order; each run's maps checked against the first control run's

host_walls.what: whole processes timed from outside, before and after the four host fixes, 4 rounds in alternating order; one depth (17 layers), both directions, stride 64, Hann. cli is inkrs sweep at depth 0; villa is villa's infer with the --engine inkrs adapter. s1_pyramid is S1 with a 3-level mean pyramid (scripts/make_pyramid.py), hybrid_3d2d-seed42; native is the PHerc. 1447 segment, reader-v2. Means of 4 pairs; ci95 is the paired saving's 95% t interval. The after arms shared one warm algorithm cache; the before builds had no algorithm cache, so each before figure includes cuDNN's timed algorithm search

villa_s1_pyramid_adapter_only.what: the same rounds' B arm (villa base with this build's wheel, warm cache) against E (with the adapter's three start-up commits): the commits' own share
